source.excerpt: قولوا -أيها المؤمنون- لهؤلاء اليهود والنَّصارى: صدَّقنا بالله الواحد المعبود بحق، وبما أنزل إلينا من القرآن الذي أوحاه الله إلى نبيه ورسوله محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، وما أنزل من الصحف إلى إبراهيم وابنيه إسماعيل وإسحاق، وإلى يعقوب والأسباط -وهم الأنبياء مِن ولد يعقوب الذين كانوا في قبائل بني إسرائيل الاثنتي عشرة- وما أُعطي موسى من التوراة، وعيسى من الإنجيل، وما أُعطي الأنبياء جميعًا من وحي ربهم،

cards.arabic: قُولُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِـۧمَ وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَٱلْأَسْبَاطِ وَمَآ أُوتِىَ مُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ وَمَآ أُوتِىَ ٱلنَّبِيُّونَ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّنْهُمْ وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ مُسْلِمُونَ
cards.translation: Sagt: Wir glauben an Allah und an das, was zu uns (als Offenbarung) herabgesandt worden ist, und an das, was zu Ibrahim, Isma’il, lshaq, Ya`qub und den Stämmen herabgesandt wurde, und (an das,) was Musa und ’Isa gegeben wurde, und (an das,) was den Propheten von ihrem Herrn gegeben wurde. Wir machen keinen Unterschied bei jemandem von ihnen, und wir sind Ihm ergeben.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: The Muslim believes in all that Allah `revealed and all the Prophets: Allah directed His believing servants to believe in what He sent down to them through His Messenger Muhammad ﷺ and in what was revealed to the previous Prophets in general.

cards.headline: Wenn sie an das gleiche glauben, woran ihr glaubt, dann sind sie somit rechtgeleitet.

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:137
source.excerpt: فإنْ آمن الكفار من اليهود والنصارى وغيرهم بمثل الذي آمنتم به، مما جاء به الرسول، فقد اهتدوا إلى الحق، وإن أعرضوا فإنما هم في خلاف شديد، فسيكفيك الله -أيها الرسول- شرَّهم وينصرك عليهم، وهو السميع لأقوالكم، العليم بأحوالكم.

cards.arabic: فَإِنْ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِمِثْلِ مَآ ءَامَنتُم بِهِۦ فَقَدِ ٱهْتَدَوا۟ ۖ وَّإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّمَا هُمْ فِى شِقَاقٍ ۖ فَسَيَكْفِيكَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
cards.translation: Wenn sie an das gleiche glauben, woran ihr glaubt, dann sind sie somit rechtgeleitet. Wenn sie sich jedoch abkehren, dann befinden sie sich in Widerstreit. Aber gegen sie wird Allah dir genügen. Er ist der Allhörende und Allwissende.

source.excerpt: الزموا دين الله الذي فطركم عليه، فليس هناك أحسنُ مِن فطرة الله التي فطر الناس عليها، فالزموها وقولوا نحن خاضعون مطيعون لربنا في اتباعنا ملَّة إبراهيم.

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:139
source.excerpt: قل -أيها الرسول لأهل الكتاب-: أتجادلوننا في توحيد الله والإخلاص له، وهو رب العالمين جميعًا، لا يختص بقوم دون قوم، ولنا أعمالنا ولكم أعمالكم، ونحن لله مخلصو العبادة والطَّاعة لا نشرك به شيئًا، ولا نعبد أحدًا غيره؟

cards.headline: Das ist eine Gemeinschaft, die schon vergangen ist; ihr kommt zu …

source.excerpt: تلك أُمَّة من أسلافكم قد مضَتْ، لهم أعمالهم ولكم أعمالكم، ولا تُسْألون عن أعمالهم، وهم لا يُسْألون عن أعمالكم. وفي الآية قطع للتعلق بالمخلوقين، وعدم الاغترار بالانتساب إليهم، وأن العبرة بالإيمان بالله وعبادته وحده، واتباع رسله، وأن من كفر برسول منهم فقد كفر بسائر الرسل.

cards.arabic: تِلْكَ أُمَّةٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ ۖ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَلَكُم مَّا كَسَبْتُمْ ۖ وَلَا تُسْـَٔلُونَ عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

source.excerpt: سيقول الجهال وضعاف العقول من اليهود وأمثالهم، في سخرية واعتراض: ما الذي صرف هؤلاء المسلمين عن قبلتهم التي كانوا يُصَلُّون إلى جهتها أول الإسلام; (وهي «بيت المقدس» ) قل لهم -أيها الرسول-: المشرق والمغرب وما بينهما ملك لله، فليست جهة من الجهات خارجة عن ملكه، يهدي مَن يشاء من عباده إلى طريق الهداية القويم. وفي هذا إشعار بأن الشأن كله لله في امتثال أوامره، فحيثما وَجَّهَنا تَوَجَّهْنا.

cards.translation: Die Toren unter den Menschen werden sagen: „Was hat sie von der Gebetsrichtung, die sie (bisher) einhielten, abgebracht? Sag: Allah gehört der Osten und der Westen. Er leitet, wen Er will, auf einen geraden Weg.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?

cards.headline: Und so haben Wir euch zu einer Gemeinschaft der Mitte gemacht …

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:143
source.excerpt: وكما هديناكم -أيها المسلمون- إلى الطريق الصحيح في الدين، جعلناكم أمة خيارًا عدولا لتشهدوا على الأمم في الآخرة أن رسلهم بلَّغتهم رسالات ربهم، ويكون الرسول في الآخرة -كذلك- شهيدًا عليكم أنَّه بلَّغكم رسالة ربه.

cards.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَـٰكُمْ أُمَّةً وَسَطًا لِّتَكُونُوا۟ شُهَدَآءَ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَيَكُونَ ٱلرَّسُولُ عَلَيْكُمْ شَهِيدًا ۗ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا ٱلْقِبْلَةَ ٱلَّتِى كُنتَ عَلَيْهَآ إِلَّا لِنَعْلَمَ مَن يَتَّبِعُ ٱلرَّسُولَ مِمَّن يَنقَلِبُ عَلَىٰ عَقِبَيْهِ ۚ وَإِن كَانَتْ لَكَبِيرَةً إِلَّا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُضِيعَ إِيمَـٰنَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِٱلنَّاسِ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
cards.translation: Und so haben Wir euch zu einer Gemeinschaft der Mitte gemacht, damit ihr Zeugen über die (anderen) Menschen seiet und damit der Gesandte über euch Zeuge sei. Wir hatten die Gebetsrichtung, die du einhieltest, nur bestimmt, um zu wissen, wer dem Gesandten folgt und wer sich auf den Fersen umkehrt. Und es ist wahrlich schwer außer für diejenigen, die Allah rechtgeleitet hat. Aber Allah läßt nicht zu, daß euer Glaube verloren geht. Allah ist zu den Menschen wahrlich Gnädig, Barmherzig.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?

cards.headline: Exposure to cement industry emissions and respiratory health outcomes

source.title: Exposure to cement industry emissions and respiratory health outcomes: a global systematic review and meta-analysis from 2000 to 2025.
source.excerpt: Cement factory emissions are significantly associated with impaired pulmonary function and increased respiratory morbidity, highlighting the need for improved occupational safety measures and environmental emission controls.

cards.headline: Artificial Intelligence-Empowered "Walking Hospitals"

source.title: Artificial Intelligence-Empowered "Walking Hospitals": A Narrative Review of Innovative Models and Ecosystem Construction in Rural Healthcare.
source.excerpt: AI-empowered "Walking Hospitals" represent a paradigm shift from hardware distribution to capability enhancement.

cards.headline: The Effect of Macular Hole Duration on Surgical Outcomes

source.title: The Effect of Macular Hole Duration on Surgical Outcomes: An Individual Participant Data Study of Randomized Controlled Trials.
source.excerpt: Symptom duration was independently associated with both anatomic and visual outcomes in persons undergoing surgery for iFTMH. Time to surgery should be minimized and care pathways designed to enable this.

cards.headline: Pediatric Eyelid Cutaneous Horns: A Case Series and Literature Review

source.title: Pediatric Eyelid Cutaneous Horns: A Case Series and Literature Review.
source.excerpt: Pediatric eyelid cutaneous horns are closely related to eyelid margin inflammatory disease and appear to follow a benign course. This contrasts with the adult population where cutaneous horns are frequently associated with neoplasia.

cards.headline: Roles and applications of artificial intelligence in fetal and placental MRI

source.title: Roles and applications of artificial intelligence in fetal and placental MRI: a literature review.
source.excerpt: This review synthesizes extensive research on AI applications in fetal and placental MRI, highlighting its potential to enhance imaging quality, automate tasks such as segmentation and motion correction, and improve diagnostic accuracy.

cards.headline: Large language models in healthcare

source.title: Large language models in healthcare: applications, evaluation frameworks, and governance pathways - a scoping review and multidimensional framework.
source.excerpt: Current evidence supports cautious deployment of LLMs in selected healthcare tasks under structured oversight. Translational progress depends on prospective evaluation, standardised reporting, equity-focused audits, and lifecycle governance with continuous monitoring.

cards.headline: Intraocular Immune Response in Human Uveitis: Time to Look Beyond Animal Models

source.title: Intraocular Immune Response in Human Uveitis: Time to Look Beyond Animal Models.
source.excerpt: The diversity of the intraocular immune response in uveitis patients remains challenging but can be studied by multiple techniques including histopathology, flow cytometry, and scRNAseq. Human data can be combined with animal studies for translating uveitis research into novel therapies.

cards.headline: Assessing Private Equity Involvement in Ophthalmology

source.title: Assessing Private Equity Involvement in Ophthalmology: Parallels With the Past, Concerns for the Future.
source.excerpt: Although investment by private equity offers potential financial rewards and operational improvements for practices, it also raises significant concerns reminiscent of those experienced by physician practice management companies in the 1990s. Non-anecdotal data are needed to assess the benefits and future of private equity involvement in ophthalmology.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence for lung cancer classification in cytology specimens

source.title: Artificial intelligence for lung cancer classification in cytology specimens: A systematic review and diagnostic test accuracy meta-analysis of benign-malignant diagnosis and ADC/SCC/SCLC subtyping.
source.excerpt: Artificial intelligence-based cytology classification achieves high diagnostic accuracy for benign-malignant discrimination and shows promising but less mature performance for histological subtyping. Prospective external validation, standardized reporting, and clinically integrated human-artificial intelligence studies are required before routine clinical deployment.

cards.headline: Artificial Intelligence in Airway Management: Current Evidence and Future Perspectives

source.title: Artificial Intelligence in Airway Management: Current Evidence and Future Perspectives.
source.excerpt: AI should be considered a complementary tool that augments clinical expertise rather than a replacement for clinician judgment.

cards.headline: Consensus Guidelines for Ocular Surveillance of von Hippel-Lindau Disease

source.title: Consensus Guidelines for Ocular Surveillance of von Hippel-Lindau Disease.
source.excerpt: Based on available evidence from observational studies, broad agreement was reached for a strategy of lifelong surveillance and early treatment for ocular VHL disease. These guidelines were endorsed by the VHL Alliance and the International Society of Ocular Oncology and were approved by the American Academy of Ophthalmology Board of Trustees.

cards.headline: Intraoperative Image Guidance in Orbital and Lacrimal Surgery

source.title: Intraoperative Image Guidance in Orbital and Lacrimal Surgery: A Report by the American Academy of Ophthalmology.
source.excerpt: A small number of comparative studies suggest that there are improved outcomes when IIG is used in orbital fracture repair, but each study suffers from various limitations. No high-quality comparative studies exist for the management of lacrimal surgery, neoplastic disease, or decompression.

cards.headline: Effects of micronutrient supplementation on immune function in older adults

source.title: Effects of micronutrient supplementation on immune function in older adults: a meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Micronutrient supplementation enhances immune function in elderly adults by reducing inflammation, increasing T lymphocyte levels, and improving antioxidant status.

cards.headline: Artificial Intelligence-Based Risk Stratification in Obesity Care

source.title: Artificial Intelligence-Based Risk Stratification in Obesity Care: From Diagnosis to Personalised Treatment Pathways.
source.excerpt: AI is positioned to become a core enabler of personalised obesity pathways. Safe translation requires external validation, bias auditing, transparent reporting, human oversight, and post-deployment surveillance aligned with clinical guidelines and regulatory expectations.

cards.headline: Wir sehen ja dein Gesicht sich (suchend) zum Himmel wenden.

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:144
source.excerpt: قد نرى تحوُّل وجهك -أيها الرسول- في جهة السماء، مرة بعد مرة; انتظارًا لنزول الوحي إليك في شأن القبلة، فلنصرفنك عن «بيت المقدس» إلى قبلة تحبها وترضاها، وهي وجهة المسجد الحرام بـ «مكة» ، فولِّ وجهك إليها. وفي أي مكان كنتم -أيها المسلمون- وأردتم الصلاة فتوجهوا نحو المسجد الحرام. وإن الذين أعطاهم الله علم الكتاب من اليهود والنصارى لَيعلمون أن تحويلك إلى الكعبة هو الحق الثابت في كتبهم.

cards.arabic: قَدْ نَرَىٰ تَقَلُّبَ وَجْهِكَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ ۖ فَلَنُوَلِّيَنَّكَ قِبْلَةً تَرْضَىٰهَا ۚ فَوَلِّ وَجْهَكَ شَطْرَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ ۚ وَحَيْثُ مَا كُنتُمْ فَوَلُّوا۟ وُجُوهَكُمْ شَطْرَهُۥ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ لَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ ۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَـٰفِلٍ عَمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ
cards.translation: Wir sehen ja dein Gesicht sich (suchend) zum Himmel wenden. Nun wollen Wir dir ganz gewiß eine Gebetsrichtung zuweisen, mit der du zufrieden bist. So wende dein Gesicht in Richtung der geschützten Gebetsstätte! Und wo immer ihr seid, wendet eure Gesichter in ihrer Richtung! Diejenigen, denen die Schrift gegeben wurde, wissen sehr wohl, daß dies die Wahrheit von ihrem Herrn ist. Und Allah ist nicht unachtsam dessen, was sie tun.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: The First Abrogation in the Qur'an was about the Qiblah: `Ali bin Abu Talhah related that Ibn `Abbas narrated: The first abrogated part in the Qur'an was about the Qiblah.

cards.headline: Selbst wenn du zu denjenigen, denen die Schrift gegeben wurde …

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:145
source.excerpt: ولئن جئتَ -أيها الرسول- الذين أُعطوا التوراة والإنجيل بكل حجة وبرهان على أن توجُّهك إلى الكعبة في الصلاة هو الحق من عند الله، ما تبعوا قبلتك عنادًا واستكبارًا، وما أنت بتابع قبلتهم مرة أخرى، وما بعضهم بتابع قبلة بعض. ولئن اتبعت أهواءهم في شأن القبلة وغيرها بعد ما جاءك من العلم بأنك على الحق وهم على الباطل، إنك حينئذ لمن الظالمين لأنفسهم.

cards.arabic: وَلَئِنْ أَتَيْتَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِكُلِّ ءَايَةٍ مَّا تَبِعُوا۟ قِبْلَتَكَ ۚ وَمَآ أَنتَ بِتَابِعٍ قِبْلَتَهُمْ ۚ وَمَا بَعْضُهُم بِتَابِعٍ قِبْلَةَ بَعْضٍ ۚ وَلَئِنِ ٱتَّبَعْتَ أَهْوَآءَهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۙ إِنَّكَ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
cards.translation: Selbst wenn du zu denjenigen, denen die Schrift gegeben wurde, mit jeglichen Zeichen kämest, würden sie doch nicht deiner Gebetsrichtung folgen; noch folgst du ihrer Gebetsrichtung. Und auch untereinander folgen sie nicht der Gebetsrichtung der anderen. Würdest du aber ihren Neigungen folgen, nach all dem, was dir an Wissen zugekommen ist, dann gehörtest du wahrlich zu den Ungerechten.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?

cards.headline: Transformer models in cardiovascular medicine

source.title: Transformer models in cardiovascular medicine: current applications, translational challenges, and future directions.
source.excerpt: This narrative review provides a focused overview of Transformer-based models in cardiovascular medicine, critically evaluates their translational limitations, and outlines priorities for clinically useful and responsible cardiovascular AI.

cards.headline: Applications of artificial intelligence in personalized nutrition interventions

source.title: Applications of artificial intelligence in personalized nutrition interventions.
source.excerpt: Realizing its potential equitably will require multi-ethnic nutrition-omics cohorts, privacy-preserving multicenter collaboration, dietitian-led human-AI collaboration, and lifecycle safety governance for generative models.

cards.headline: Latest advances in white spot syndromes: New findings and interpretations

source.title: Latest advances in white spot syndromes: New findings and interpretations.
source.publisher: Progress in retinal and eye research
source.excerpt: By integrating MMI into the diagnosis and management of these conditions, this review aims to enhance patient outcomes and provide valuable insights into the complexities surrounding WSS.

cards.headline: Inappropriate Use of the Term "Papilledema" in the Medical Literature

source.title: Inappropriate Use of the Term "Papilledema" in the Medical Literature: A Systematic Review of Case Reports across Specialties.
source.excerpt: "Papilledema" is widely misused even among ophthalmology case reports. When allowed to propagate, this error can mislead care delivery to patients with ODE. Our results, although limited to case reports, indicate a need for more thorough peer-review standards and neuro-ophthalmology exposure in medical education.

cards.headline: Longitudinal Imaging and Temporal Deep Learning for Dynamic Risk Prediction in Lung Cancer

source.title: Longitudinal Imaging and Temporal Deep Learning for Dynamic Risk Prediction in Lung Cancer: Current Progress and Future Perspectives.
source.excerpt: Taken together, longitudinal imaging and temporal deep learning are steering lung cancer AI away from static image analysis and toward dynamic disease management, with the potential to support continuous risk assessment and potentially inform adaptive clinical decision-making throughout the full spectrum of lung cancer care.

cards.headline: Artificial Intelligence in Echocardiography for Acute Coronary Syndromes

source.title: Artificial Intelligence in Echocardiography for Acute Coronary Syndromes: Current Evidence and Integration With Electrocardiography and Biomarkers.
source.excerpt: AI-enhanced echocardiography represents a promising step toward precision cardiovascular imaging and may become the central imaging component of future multimodal diagnostic pathways for patients with suspected ACS.

cards.headline: BACILLARY LAYER DETACHMENT

source.title: BACILLARY LAYER DETACHMENT: MULTIMODAL IMAGING AND HISTOLOGIC EVIDENCE OF A NOVEL OPTICAL COHERENCE TOMOGRAPHY TERMINOLOGY: Literature Review and Proposed Theory.
source.excerpt: This review serves to strengthen the OCT nomenclature "bacillary layer detachment," based on specific reflectance information obtained by OCT and previously published histologic observations.

cards.headline: Histiocytosis Advancements Parallel Ophthalmic Innovations

source.title: Histiocytosis Advancements Parallel Ophthalmic Innovations: The LXXXI Edward Jackson Memorial Lecture.
source.excerpt: The explosion of molecular genetics technology and targeted therapies has revolutionized cancer treatment, including histiocytosis and ophthalmic oncology. Recent progress in both fields has shown how these seemingly disparate areas have many intersections, and this speaks to the collaborative spirit that is inherent in clinical research.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence in spinal fracture imaging

source.title: Artificial intelligence in spinal fracture imaging: from clinical application to translational promise.
source.excerpt: We identify persistent gaps, including underuse of foundation models and public benchmarks, and limited independent evaluation of commercial tools.

cards.headline: Advances in AI for detecting pulmonary inflammation and perioperative medicine

source.title: Advances in AI for detecting pulmonary inflammation and perioperative medicine: a mini-review.
source.excerpt: In conclusion, AI offers accurate, scalable solutions for pulmonary inflammation diagnostics, with significant potential to augment clinical decision-making and extend into proactive areas like perioperative medicine for complication screening and prevention.

cards.headline: Applications of the Guarded-Needle External Drainage Technique in Vitreoretinal Surgery

source.title: Applications of the Guarded-Needle External Drainage Technique in Vitreoretinal Surgery.
source.excerpt: The guarded-needle external drainage has a wide range of applications in vitreoretinal surgery.

cards.headline: Diabetic retinal disease cure accelerator: Modernizing staging and endpoints

source.title: Diabetic retinal disease cure accelerator: Modernizing staging and endpoints.
source.publisher: Progress in retinal and eye research
source.excerpt: Ultimately, this precision-based approach aims to transform DRD diagnosis and treatment, accelerating the access of patients worldwide to therapies that reduce diabetes-related vision loss.

cards.headline: From underdiagnosis to scalable screening

source.title: From underdiagnosis to scalable screening: Applications of artificial intelligence for vertebral compression fracture detection - a systematic review and meta-analysis of diagnostic performance.
source.excerpt: AI models demonstrate high diagnostic accuracy for VCF detection, particularly in CT imaging. However, improved detection alone does not ensure better outcomes, as substantial treatment gaps persist.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence for the assessment of diastolic function

source.title: Artificial intelligence for the assessment of diastolic function.
source.excerpt: Machine learning and deep learning approaches can integrate multidimensional echocardiographic features, electrocardiographic signals, and clinical variables to identify latent physiologic patterns beyond conventional rule-based algorithms.

cards.headline: Diejenigen, denen Wir die Schrift gegeben haben, kennen es, wie sie ihre Söhne kennen.

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:146
source.excerpt: الذين أعطيناهم التوراة والإنجيل من أحبار اليهود وعلماء النصارى يعرفون أنَّ محمدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم رسول الله بأوصافه المذكورة في كتبهم، مثل معرفتهم أبنائهم. وإن فريقًا منهم ليكتمون الحق وهم يعلمون صِدْقه، وثبوت أوصافه.

cards.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ يَعْرِفُونَهُۥ كَمَا يَعْرِفُونَ أَبْنَآءَهُمْ ۖ وَإِنَّ فَرِيقًا مِّنْهُمْ لَيَكْتُمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
cards.translation: Diejenigen, denen Wir die Schrift gegeben haben, kennen es, wie sie ihre Söhne kennen. Aber ein Teil von ihnen verheimlicht wahrlich die Wahrheit, obwohl sie (sie) wissen.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?

cards.headline: (Es ist) die Wahrheit von deinem Herrn, gehöre daher nicht zu den Zweiflern!

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:147
source.excerpt: الذي أنزل إليك -أيها النبي- هو الحق من ربك، فلا تكونن من الشاكين فيه. وهذا وإن كان خطابا للرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم فهو موجه للأمة.

cards.arabic: ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ ۖ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُمْتَرِينَ
cards.translation: (Es ist) die Wahrheit von deinem Herrn, gehöre daher nicht zu den Zweiflern!

cards.headline: Prospective Evidence on Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Melanoma Diagnostics

source.title: Prospective Evidence on Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Melanoma Diagnostics: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
source.excerpt: In the systematic review and meta-analysis of prospective settings, AI systems perform at comparable levels to dermatologists for melanoma diagnostics and may enhance performance when used as a decision-support tool. However, the frequent risk of bias and limited generalizability of current studies highlight the need for broader validation in unselected patient populations in the clinical setting.

cards.headline: Clinical application of artificial intelligence technology in epilepsy

source.title: Clinical application of artificial intelligence technology in epilepsy.
source.excerpt: The primary objectives of this review are to delineate the current status of the clinical application of AI in epilepsy, clarify emerging future trends, and ultimately provide practical references and actionable insights for clinical practitioners.

cards.headline: The Trouble With Photodynamic Therapy

source.title: The Trouble With Photodynamic Therapy.
source.excerpt: In the United States, finding a retina specialist who performs PDT is challenging for patients with diseases for which it is indicated. Obtaining coverage for CSR is difficult for retina specialists treating patients with CSR in the United States, but not internationally. As a result, delayed or no treatment for cases indicated leads to avoidable loss of vision.

cards.headline: Charity Care in Ophthalmology, 2024

source.title: Charity Care in Ophthalmology, 2024.
source.excerpt: Charity eye care in ophthalmology in 2024 is a patchwork of transient, local efforts that have a few common themes: absent material basis for sustainability, a narrowing base of support by clinicians, transfer of care to training programs, and financial vetting of applicants by nonclinicians.

cards.headline: Accuracy of AI-assisted diagnostic tools for Schistosoma haematobium

source.title: Accuracy of AI-assisted diagnostic tools for Schistosoma haematobium: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: AI-assisted microscopic diagnosis of S. haematobium achieved very good in this meta-analysis. These automated tools, whether smartphone-based or bench-top systems, showed promise for detecting infections and could help screen populations in endemic areas.

cards.headline: Artificial Intelligence for Neonatal Sepsis Prediction

source.title: Artificial Intelligence for Neonatal Sepsis Prediction: A Review of Advances, Clinical Integration, and Future Prospects.
source.excerpt: The goal is an equitable, globally applicable partnership between AI and the clinician.

cards.headline: PARS PLANA VITRECTOMY WITH OR WITHOUT INTERNAL LIMITING MEMBRANE PEEL FOR MACULAR HOLE

source.excerpt: Pars plana vitrectomy with and without ILM peel achieved a similar final BCVA. However, pars plana vitrectomy without ILM peeling achieved a better final BCVA in eyes with closed MHs. ILM peeling achieved a greater primary MH closure rate and reduced need for reoperation.

cards.headline: Endogenous Fungal Endophthalmitis

source.title: Endogenous Fungal Endophthalmitis: A Single-Center Retrospective Study and Review of the Literature.
source.excerpt: Initial systemic treatment decisions in patients with EFE were driven by systemic culture positivity, systemic symptoms, or comorbidities. Intravitreal antifungal therapy may be insufficient to arrest progression of chorioretinal lesions in some cases.

cards.headline: Evaluation metrics for synthetic medical imaging

source.title: Evaluation metrics for synthetic medical imaging.
source.excerpt: Evaluation strategies for synthetic medical imaging showed substantial variability and no single metric captured fidelity, realism, diversity, and clinical validity simultaneously. Metric choice is often dictated by data availability rather than clinical purpose. A task-specific, layered evaluation framework could improve comparability and facilitate clinical adoption.

cards.headline: Identifying and alleviating ethical risks of artificial intelligence in physical education

source.title: Identifying and alleviating ethical risks of artificial intelligence in physical education: a systematic review.
source.excerpt: Achieving trustworthy AIPE requires balancing technological reliability, appropriateness for physical education, and the preservation of human agency. This study provides a theoretical reference for the ethical governance of AIPE within the field of public health.

cards.headline: Inner-retinal changes in AMD: Evidence, mechanisms, and future perspectives

source.title: Inner-retinal changes in AMD: Evidence, mechanisms, and future perspectives.
source.publisher: Progress in retinal and eye research
source.excerpt: By integrating structural, functional, and systemic insights, this review reframes AMD as a multi-layer neurovascular disease and underscores the central role of inner-retinal integrity in future AMD research and management.

cards.headline: Use of Mitomycin C in Dacryocystorhinostomy

source.title: Use of Mitomycin C in Dacryocystorhinostomy: A Report by the American Academy of Ophthalmology.
source.excerpt: Intraoperative use of MMC in external and endoscopic endonasal DCR has been shown to improve functional and anatomic outcomes compared with controls in some series, but there is no agreement on the recommended concentration or application time for MMC in DCR.

cards.headline: Machine learning-based methods in diagnosing cardiac amyloidosis: a meta-analysis

source.title: Machine learning-based methods in diagnosing cardiac amyloidosis: a meta-analysis.

cards.arabic: وَلَا تَقُولُوا۟ لِمَن يُقْتَلُ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أَمْوَٰتٌۢ ۚ بَلْ أَحْيَآءٌ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا تَشْعُرُونَ
cards.translation: Und sagt nicht von denen, die auf Allahs Weg getötet werden, sie seien tot! Nein! Vielmehr sind sie lebendig; aber ihr nehmt es nicht wahr.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: The Virtue of Patience and Prayer: After Allah commanded that He be appreciated, He ordained patience and prayer. It is a fact that the servant is either enjoying a bounty that he should be thankful for, or suffering a calamity that he should meet with patience.

cards.headline: Und Wir werden euch ganz gewiß mit ein wenig Furcht und Hunger und Mangel an Besitz …

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:155
source.excerpt: ولنختبرنكم بشيء يسير من الخوف، ومن الجوع، وبنقص من الأموال بتعسر الحصول عليها، أو ذهابها، ومن الأنفس: بالموت أو الشهادة في سبيل الله، وبنقص من ثمرات النخيل والأعناب والحبوب، بقلَّة ناتجها أو فسادها. وبشِّر -أيها النبي- الصابرين على هذا وأمثاله بما يفرحهم ويَسُرُّهم من حسن العاقبة في الدنيا والآخرة.

cards.arabic: وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكُم بِشَىْءٍ مِّنَ ٱلْخَوْفِ وَٱلْجُوعِ وَنَقْصٍ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْوَٰلِ وَٱلْأَنفُسِ وَٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ

cards.headline: Gewiß, as-Safa und al-Marwa gehören zu den (Orten der) Kulthandlungen Allahs.

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:158
source.excerpt: إن الصفا والمروة -وهما جبلان صغيران قرب الكعبة من جهة الشرق- من معالم دين الله الظاهرة التي تعبَّد الله عباده بالسعي بينهما. فمَن قصد الكعبة حاجًّا أو معتمرًا، فلا إثم عليه ولا حرج في أن يسعى بينهما، بل يجب عليه ذلك، ومن فعل الطاعات طواعية من نفسه مخلصًا بها لله تعالى، فإن الله تعالى شاكر يثيب على القليل بالكثير، عليم بأعمال عباده فلا يضيعها، ولا يبخس أحدًا مثقال ذرة.

cards.arabic: ۞ إِنَّ ٱلصَّفَا وَٱلْمَرْوَةَ مِن شَعَآئِرِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَمَنْ حَجَّ ٱلْبَيْتَ أَوِ ٱعْتَمَرَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِ أَن يَطَّوَّفَ بِهِمَا ۚ وَمَن تَطَوَّعَ خَيْرًا فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَاكِرٌ عَلِيمٌ
cards.translation: Gewiß, as-Safa und al-Marwa gehören zu den (Orten der) Kulthandlungen Allahs. Wenn einer die Pilgerfahrt zum Hause oder die Besuchsfahrt vollzieht, so ist es keine Sünde für ihn, wenn er zwischen ihnen (beiden) den Umgang macht. Und wer (von sich aus) freiwillig Gutes tut, so ist Allah Dankbar und Allwissend.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?

cards.headline: Diejenigen, die verheimlichen, was Wir an klaren Beweisen und Rechtleitung hinabgesandt …

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:159
source.excerpt: إن الذين يُخْفون ما أنزلنا من الآيات الواضحات الدالة على نبوة محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم وما جاء به، وهم أحبار اليهود وعلماء النصارى وغيرهم ممن يكتم ما أنزل الله من بعد ما أظهرناه للناس في التوراة والإنجيل، أولئك يطردهم الله من رحمته، ويدعو عليهم باللعنة جميع الخليقة.

cards.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَكْتُمُونَ مَآ أَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ وَٱلْهُدَىٰ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا بَيَّنَّـٰهُ لِلنَّاسِ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ۙ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يَلْعَنُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَيَلْعَنُهُمُ ٱللَّـٰعِنُونَ
cards.translation: Diejenigen, die verheimlichen, was Wir an klaren Beweisen und Rechtleitung hinabgesandt haben, nachdem Wir es den Menschen in der Schrift klar gemacht haben, sie werden von Allah verflucht und auch von den Fluchenden, -
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
